theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  simp only
  intro y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  set x₀ := fiberMap 0
  set x₁ := fiberMap 1
  set P_i := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) coeffs
  set new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      
      have h2 : 2^(ℓ - i) = 2^(ℓ - (i + 1)) * 2 := by
        conv_rhs => enter[2]; rw [←Nat.pow_one 2]
        rw [←pow_add]; congr
        rw [Nat.sub_add_eq_sub_sub_rev (h1 := by omega) (h2 := by omega)]
        -- ⊢ ℓ - ↑i = ℓ - (↑i + 1 - 1)
        rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel (n := i) (m := 1)]
      omega
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1)) (i := 1)
      · omega
      · omega
    ⟩)
  have h_eval_qMap_x₀ : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval x₀.val = y := by
    have h := iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) x₀
    simp only [Subtype.eq_iff] at h
    rw [h.symm]
    have h_res := is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i (steps := 1) (by omega)
      (x := x₀) (y := y).mpr (by rw [pointToIterateQuotientIndex_qMap_total_fiber_eq_self])
    rw [h_res]
    -- exact qMap_eval_fiber_eq_self ⟦L⟧ ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ (by simp only; omega) h_i_succ_lt y 0
  have h_eval_qMap_x₁ : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval x₁.val = y := by
    have h := iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) x₁
    simp only [Subtype.eq_iff] at h
    rw [h.symm]
    have h_res := is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i (steps := 1) (by omega)
      (x := x₁) (y := y).mpr (by rw [pointToIterateQuotientIndex_qMap_total_fiber_eq_self])
    rw [h_res]
  have h_fiber_diff : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    have h₀ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have h₁ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    simp only [x₁, x₀, fiberMap, h₁, h₀, Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue,
      one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add,
      Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
    ring
  set P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  set P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  set P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_P_i_eval := evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs
  -- Equation 39 : P^(i)(X) = P₀^(i+1)(q^(i)(X)) + X · P₁^(i+1)(q^(i)(X))
  have h_equation_39_x₀ : P_i.eval x₀.val = P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [h_P_i_eval, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
      h_eval_qMap_x₀, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, P_i, P₀, P₁]
  have h_equation_39_x₁ : P_i.eval x₁.val = P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [h_P_i_eval, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
      h_eval_qMap_x₁, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, P_i, P₀, P₁]
  set f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩) => P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  set f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  -- Unfold the definition of f_i_plus_1 using the fold function
  
  -- Main calculation following the outline
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
    = f_i x₀ * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        f_i x₁ * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := rfl
    _ = P_i.eval x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by dsimp
    _ = (P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val) * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        (P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val) * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by
      rw [h_equation_39_x₀, h_equation_39_x₁]
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal + r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) +
        P₁.eval y.val * (x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
          x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val)) := by ring
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * ((1 - r_chal) * (x₁.val - x₀.val)) +
        P₁.eval y.val * ((x₁.val - x₀.val) * r_chal) := by ring
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal := by rw [h_fiber_diff]; ring
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P_i_plus_1, P₀, P₁, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
        intermediateEvaluationPoly]
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
      rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring

  ⟩) coeffs

      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  set x₀ := fiberMap 0
  set x₁ := fiberMap 1
  have hx : x₁.val = 1 + x₀.val := by
    have h₀ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have h₁ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    simp only [x₁, x₀, fiberMap, h₁, h₀, Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue,
      one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add,
      Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  set P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  set P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_eval (k : Fin 2) :
      P_i.eval (fiberMap k).val = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    have hq := congrArg Subtype.val h
    dsimp only at hq
    simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←hq, P₀, P₁]
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
    = (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
      dsimp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, f_i]
      rw [h_eval 0, h_eval 1, hx]
      ring
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P_i_plus_1, P₀, P₁, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
        intermediateEvaluationPoly, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
        Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  set x₀ := fiberMap 0
  set x₁ := fiberMap 1
  have hx : x₁.val = 1 + x₀.val := by
    have h₀ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have h₁ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    simp only [x₁, x₀, fiberMap, h₁, h₀, Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue,
      one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add,
      Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  set P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  set P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_eval (k : Fin 2) :
      P_i.eval (fiberMap k).val = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    have hq := congrArg Subtype.val h
    dsimp only at hq
    simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←hq, P₀, P₁]
  calc
    f_i_plus_1 y = (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
      dsimp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, f_i]
      rw [h_eval 0, h_eval 1, hx]
      ring
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P_i_plus_1, P₀, P₁, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
        intermediateEvaluationPoly, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
        Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      rfl

  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hx : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    simp only [fiberMap,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add,
      Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  set P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  set P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_eval (k : Fin 2) :
      P_i.eval (fiberMap k).val = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff] at h
    simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h, P₀, P₁]
  trans (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val
  · dsimp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, f_i]
    rw [h_eval 0, h_eval 1, hx]
    ring
  · simp only [P_i_plus_1, P₀, P₁, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl

  ⟩) coeffs

      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hx : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    simp only [fiberMap,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add,
      Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  set P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  set P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h (k : Fin 2) := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
    (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  simp only [fiberMap, iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff] at h
  trans (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val
  · dsimp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, f_i]
    simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h, P₀, P₁]
    rw [hx]
    ring
  · dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, P₀, P₁, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, mul_assoc, ←Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hx : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    simp only [fiberMap,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add,
      Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  have h (k : Fin 2) := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
    (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  simp only [fiberMap, iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff] at h
  trans (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val + r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  · dsimp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, f_i]
    simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h]
    rw [hx]
    ring
  · dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl

  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  have h (k : Fin 2) := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
    (qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
      (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y) k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff] at h
  trans (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val + r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  · dsimp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, f_i]
    simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h]
    simp only [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add,
      Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
    ring
  · dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have h (k : Fin 2) := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
    (qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
      (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y) k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff] at h
  have hx := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y
  simp only [Subtype.eq_iff, Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul,
    get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1] at hx
  trans (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val + r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  · dsimp only [fold]
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h]
    simp only [hx,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
    ring
  · rw [←Polynomial.eval_C_mul, ←Polynomial.eval_C_mul, ←Polynomial.eval_add]
    congr 1
    dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib, ←mul_assoc,
      ←Polynomial.C_mul, ←add_mul, ←Polynomial.C_add]
    rfl

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have h (k : Fin 2) := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
    _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff] at h
  have hx (k : Fin 2) := congrArg Subtype.val
    (qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y k)
  simp only [Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul,
    get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1] at hx
  trans (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val + r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  · dsimp only [fold]
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h]
    simp only [hx,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
    ring
  · dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have h k := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
    _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  have hx := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff,
    Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul,
    get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1] at h hx
  trans (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val + r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  · dsimp only [fold]
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h]
    simp only [hx,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
    ring
  · dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have h k := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
    _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  have hx := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff,
    Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul,
    get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1] at h hx
  trans (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val + r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val

    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h]
    simp only [hx,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
    ring
  · dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have h k := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
    _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  have hx := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff,
    Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul,
    get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1] at h hx
  trans (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val + r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  · simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h]
    simp only [hx,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
    ring
  · dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have h k := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
    _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  have hx := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff,
    Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul,
    get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1] at h hx
  trans (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val + r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  · simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h]
    simp [hx, Fin2ToF2]
    ring
  · dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have h k := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
    _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  have hx := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff,
    Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul,
    get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1] at h hx
  trans (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val + r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  · simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h]
    simp only [hx,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
    ring
  · dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_C_mul, add_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have h k := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
    _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  have hx := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff,
    Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul,
    get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1] at h hx
  trans (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val + r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  · simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h]
    simp only [hx,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
    ring
  · dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly]
    simp_rw [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_C_mul,
      Finset.mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_mul, mul_assoc]
    rfl

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have h k := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
    _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  have hx := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff,
    Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul,
    get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1] at h hx
  trans (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val + r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  · simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h]
    simp only [hx,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
    generalize (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val = a,
      (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val = b
    ring
  · dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_C_mul, add_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl

  ⟩) coeffs

      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have h k := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
    _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  have hx := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff,
    Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul,
    get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1] at h hx
  trans (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val + r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  · simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h]
    simp only [hx,
      Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
    ring
  · dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_C_mul, add_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have h k := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
    _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  have hx := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff,
    Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul,
    get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1] at h hx
  trans (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val + r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  · simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h]
    simp only [hx,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
    ring
  · dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_C_mul, add_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl
